fields.name: League of Legends
fields.description: League of Legends is a fast-paced, team-based strategy game where two teams of five powerful champions face off to destroy each other's base. Players choose from a diverse roster of over 170 champions to make epic plays, secure objectives, and battle their way to victory on the iconic map, Summoner's Rift

fields.name: GTA Online
fields.description: GTA Online is a story-driven, open-world multiplayer action game where players create a unique criminal avatar and build an underworld empire in the fictional city of Los Santos and Blaine County. Accessible through Grand Theft Auto V or as a standalone title, it blends massive cooperative heists, competitive racing, dynamic freemode activities and much more.

fields.name: Counter-Strike 2
fields.description: Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) is a free-to-play, first-person shooter and the technical successor to Counter-Strike: Global Offensive. Built on Valve's Source 2 engine, it features upgraded graphics, reactive volumetric smoke grenades, and "sub-tick" server architecture for hyper-responsive gameplay. It retains the classic objective-based team combat.

fields.name: Fortnite
fields.description: Fortnite is a massively popular free-to-play online video game released by Epic Games in 2017. It has evolved from a single battle royale shooter into a massive digital entertainment platform featuring multiple modes, including a 100-player survival competition, co-op tower defense, creator-made islands, rhythm games, and racing
